purpose.en: Keep microphone, camera, and speaker indicators aligned with real browser media state while recovering stalled remote subscriptions within a bounded grace period.
purpose.zh: 让麦克风、摄像头和扬声器图标与浏览器真实媒体状态一致，并在有限宽限时间后恢复卡住的远端订阅。

en: Show orange while microphone, camera, or speaker playback is still being confirmed, and green only after a live local track or real remote playback is observed.
Rebuild stale remote audio and video subscriptions after a six-second grace period.
Serialize rapid media toggles and rebuild both publisher tracks when Safari grants a second device.
zh: 麦克风、摄像头或扬声器仍在确认时显示橙色；仅在检测到真实本机轨道或远端实际播放后显示绿色。
远端音频或视频订阅失效超过六秒后自动重建。
串行处理快速媒体开关；Safari 授权第二个设备时重建两条发布轨道。

en: Classroom and meeting microphone, camera, speaker, publisher-track, and receiver-subscription state.
zh: 影响课堂及会议中的麦克风、摄像头、扬声器、发布轨道和接收订阅状态。

en: Check local MediaStreamTrack readiness every two seconds and clear stale enabled state after six seconds.
Confirm remote audio from actual element playback and retry missing or ended receiver tracks.
Keep device changes ordered so fast clicks cannot leave UI and publisher state out of sync.
zh: 每两秒检查本机 MediaStreamTrack 状态，并在失效六秒后清除过期的启用状态。
根据媒体元素实际播放确认远端音频，并重试缺失或已结束的接收轨道。
按顺序执行设备变更，避免快速点击造成界面与发布状态不同步。

en: Run focused media-health and receiver-recovery tests, stability contract checks, repository lint/tests, production build, deployment, and exact project evidence.
zh: 运行媒体健康与接收恢复测试、稳定性契约检查、仓库 lint/测试、生产构建、部署及精确项目证据。

en: The requested multi-user realtime browser session is waived for this shared RealtimeKit fix; no brand, product, payment, data, or infrastructure behavior changes.
zh: 按要求免除本次共享 RealtimeKit 修复的多人实时浏览器会话；不改变品牌、产品、付款、数据或基础设施行为。

en: Preserve greatlovemeta.com branding, data, session/API behavior, existing features, and independent infrastructure.
zh: 保留 greatlovemeta.com 的品牌、数据、会话/API 行为、既有功能及独立基础设施。

rollback.en: Roll back the application release; no data migration is required.
rollback.zh: 回滚应用版本；无需数据迁移。
